headline: Financial institutions are struggling to scale multi-agent AI beyond pilots, per Capgemini research
body: Financial institutions are struggling to scale multi-agent AI beyond pilots, according to Capgemini research. The research says 59% of banks and insurers are piloting or deploying the technology, but just 10% have achieved enterprise-wide orchestration.
note: The gap sits between running pilots and coordinating several agents across a whole firm, the step where a bank or insurer has to manage how its agents work together.

figure.label: Banks and insurers with enterprise-wide AI orchestration

evidence.text: Financial institutions are struggling to scale multi-agent AI beyond pilot projects, with just 10% of banks and insurers having achieved enterprise-wide orchestration despite 59% piloting or deploying the technology, according to Capgemini research.
